stories.headline: World court rules Myanmar committed genocide
stories.summary: The ICJ finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against the Rohingya, the first such ruling against a state.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
stories.summary: The three leaders meet in Shenzhen and sign a four-point joint peace declaration.

stories.headline: Anthropic jumps 17% in Nasdaq debut
stories.summary: Shares close at $97 on day one; US stocks fall a fifth straight day and the Nikkei drops 4.8%.

stories.headline: Allies meet in Berlin; Crimea bridge hit again
stories.summary: Europe says it is ready to talk to Russia as Ukraine strikes the bridge for the third time this week.

stories.headline: Houthi missile damages Riyadh tower
stories.summary: A missile hits the Saudi sovereign wealth fund tower in the capital's financial district.

stories.headline: GTA 6 launch tops $2.3 billion
stories.summary: The game goes on sale worldwide after 13 years; launch sales top $2.3 billion.
